name: Nuvio
subtitle: Your media library, now with Netflix-style streaming.
description:
Nuvio is a free, open-source media app: bring your own sources and it turns them into a library with artwork, ratings, subtitles and your place saved on every screen.

This source carries an enhanced Nuvio build focused on smooth playback: quality adapts to your connection the way Netflix does, without reloads or loading screens.

apps.name: Nuvio
apps.subtitle: Media app with Netflix-style adaptive quality.
apps.localizedDescription:
Bring your own sources. Nuvio turns them into a library with artwork, ratings, subtitles, and your place saved on every screen.

WHAT'S DIFFERENT IN THIS BUILD

• Adaptive quality, like Netflix
Nuvio measures your connection while you watch. When it slows down, playback moves to a lighter source at the exact same moment; when it recovers, it climbs back up. Switches happen silently, with no reload, no loading screen and no pop-ups.

• Seamless swaps
A hidden second player prepares the new quality in the background, checks it is the same cut of the video, and takes over on the exact frame, so the picture just gets sharper or softer.

• Quality menu
Tap the quality pill in the player to choose Auto or lock a resolution (2160p, 1080p, 720p, 480p). If a source for that quality doesn't match the video, Nuvio tries another one before giving up.

• Fast start
If your chosen source is slow to open, playback starts on 720p straight away and steps up to your pick a few seconds later.

• Scrub previews
Drag the timeline to see a thumbnail of the frame you're seeking to.

• Instant next episode
During the next-episode countdown, the next episode is loaded in the background so it starts with no wait.

NOTES

• Installs alongside the official Nuvio app (separate bundle ID).
• Sign in with your Nuvio account to sync your library, progress and addons.
• Nuvio is free software under GPL-3.0. Based on NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile 0.6.2.

versions.localizedDescription: Smoother Disney+-style rotation into and out of the player, cleaner Continue Watching, plus the new player, auto quality and fixes.
Disney+-style player and episode list, automatic source and quality (lean 4K, can be turned off in Settings), Apple TV-style scrubbing, AirPlay, smoother rotation, audio and lock-screen fixes.

Fixed
• Scrub preview thumbnails now appear above the timeline while you drag.

New
• Netflix-style adaptive quality: drops quality when your connection slows and climbs back when it recovers, silently.
• Seamless quality swaps with no reload or loading screen, timed to the exact frame.
• Quality menu in the player: Auto, or lock 2160p / 1080p / 720p / 480p.
• Fast start: slow sources begin on 720p and step up to your pick.
• Scrub preview thumbnails on the timeline.
• Next episode preloads during the countdown and starts instantly.

Improved
• Sources with a different cut or length are detected and skipped automatically.
• Stuttering playback is detected, not just long stalls.
• Fixed the buffered-amount reading in the iOS player.
